name: Punctuation Restoration in Medical Consumer Health Questions in Bangla
description: This dataset contains Bengali (Bangla) medical consumer health questions collected from an online medical consultation platform for punctuation restoration research in NLP. After data cleaning, spelling correction, punctuation review, and sensitive information removal, 29,44 questions were retained. Each question was annotated using five punctuation labels: O (no punctuation), COMMA, PERIOD, QUESTION, and COLON. The dataset supports the development and evaluation of machine learning and deep learning models for punctuation restoration, Bengali text preprocessing, and readability improvement. This resource is particularly valuable for low-resource language processing and domain-specific NLP research. It is intended for research and educational purposes, and users should consult the accompanying documentation for details on data format, annotation, preprocessing, and permitted use. We have also provided an English translation of our prepared Bengali dataset in a separate .xlsx file.
